# Kirk Wessman

> Solutions Engineer and Technical Leader with 15+ years of experience across Wall Street data platforms and enterprise SaaS. Based in Santa Monica, CA. Building entrepreneurial ventures alongside his day job using AI-assisted prototyping.

## About Kirk

Kirk Wessman is a customer-facing technical leader specializing in designing, prototyping, and deploying complex API- and data-driven systems. He translates ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions through close collaboration with product, engineering, and executive stakeholders.

He has deep experience with:
- Enterprise software: CPQ (Configure Price Quote), CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management), and complex deal structures
- Data platforms and Wall Street-grade financial systems
- AI/LLM tooling and AI-assisted development
- Full-stack prototyping: Next.js/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, Solidity/blockchain

GitHub: https://github.com/DiogenesofAthens

## Ventures

Kirk is building a portfolio of entrepreneurial ventures:

- **PortKey** (https://portkey-one.vercel.app) — Mortgage portability neobank. Homeowners carry their existing low-rate mortgage to a new property instead of refinancing.
- **fareTrader** (https://fare-trader.vercel.app) — Autonomous Python agent that monitors Delta Air Lines first-class fares and auto-books when prices drop below a configured threshold.
- **ResourXe** (https://resourxe.vercel.app) — GPU compute routing engine. Scores cloud GPU instances by price and carbon intensity using live data from Vast.ai and WattTime.
- **Save the State** (https://save-the-state.vercel.app) — Blockchain-anchored land covenant registry targeting county government.
- **Re-Open** (https://re-open.us) — Civic engagement platform focused on renewing American society.
- **Prince of Mulberry Productions** (https://princeofmulberry.com) — Film and media production company.
